heading: INT. CONVERTED BOWLING ALLEY COURTROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. CONVERTED BOWLING ALLEY COURTROOM - DAY
Lane six has been boarded over to serve as the well of the court.
The bench is a ball return with a raised platform.
Pins are painted on the wall behind the jury box.
JUDGE KOWALCZYK, sixties, stocky, in robes over a polo shirt, taps a gavel made from a bowling pin.
At the plaintiff's table, ATTORNEY SEUN ADEBAYO, thirties, stands with a legal pad.
At the defence table, ATTORNEY GRACE PELLETIER, forties, fidgets with a pen.
In the witness chair, an UNKNOWN WITNESS in a lab coat waits.
By the door, BAILIFF GUS, twenties, eats sunflower seeds.
Please state your name for the record.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: I am a forensic engineer.
units.name: WITNESS

units.text: Your name.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: Objection. Asked and not answered.
units.name: PELLETIER

units.text: Overruled. Let her finish.
units.name: KOWALCZYK

units.text: Dr. Isolde Varga.
units.name: WITNESS

units.text: Dr. Varga, did you inspect the lane that night?
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: I did. The oil pattern was uneven by almost four feet.
units.name: VARGA

units.text: Objection, speculation.
units.name: PELLETIER

units.text: It's her job, counsel. Sit down.
units.name: KOWALCZYK

units.text: Your Honor-
units.name: PELLETIER

units.text: She measured it, Your Honor, she didn't guess.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: I said sit down.
units.name: KOWALCZYK

units.text: Strike.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Bailiff!
units.name: KOWALCZYK

units.text: Sorry, sir. Habit.
units.name: GUS

units.text: May I continue?
units.name: VARGA

units.text: Please.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: Objection!
units.name: PELLETIER

units.text: Overruled. Overruled. All of it. Go.
units.name: KOWALCZYK

units.text: The pattern was consistent with deliberate tampering.
units.name: VARGA

units.text: A silence.
Pelletier drops her pen.
It rolls across the floor and into the gutter.
Well. That's a spare.
units.name: KOWALCZYK
